_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.44.0, and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.61.0, both adding MySQL 8.0+ as a second database backend (a Database Connections type picker, mysql:// connection strings, and a correctly-rendered SQL panel for MySQL's backtick-quoted SQL) -- paired with this release's own saved-connection dbType fix below.
